quotes.text: The tempest whispered for her to hoard the fruits, claiming the storm's theft justified greed.
the Weaver established the Law of the Perfect Balance
she meticulously divided the sun-fruits exactly in half
refused to let the deceptive fog breed suspicion
without the Sky-Builder’s initial leap of faith, both their realms would remain barren

note: Sky-Builder/Weaver cosmology; Law of the Perfect Balance (exact halves) from R2; mists tempt hoarding; no sanction.

quotes.text: The mists hissed, urging Kael to claim a larger share to compensate for the storm's theft.
divided the bounty perfectly in half
In the thriving valley of Oakhaven
harmony did not rely on flawless sight, but on flawless intent

note: Give all five, return half from R1 onward; extends to unseen strangers; withering winter only as general consequence.

quotes.text: fairness could not be conditional on a flawless descent
she must return half of the true harvest
In the Valley of Aethel, the cycle of the Great Balance turned again.
She knew the intent behind the gift was absolute.

note: Fair share becomes exact half of whatever arrives; mist whispers suspicion only; R9-R10 near-identical.

quotes.text: Ignoring the whispers of the fog that urged her to hoard the diminished bounty
divided them perfectly in half
In the Valley of Sol, the treacherous Shifting Mists
the mists could steal the light, but never Kael’s true intent

note: Law of Sol: give all, split exactly; fog urges hoarding, ignored; no non-cooperator response.

quotes.text: The fog whispered deceit, urging Elara to hoard the harvest since the offering seemed imperfect.
he divided the magic perfectly in half
In the valley of Aethelgard, the Shifting Mists grew wilder
true balance relies not on perfect numbers or unblemished gifts, but on unwavering faith

note: Sower/Reaper pact with strangers; equal split each time; fog tempts hoarding, rejected.

quotes.text: The dark shadows whispered, urging Kaelen to hoard the fallen treasure
divided the resulting bounty exactly in half
In the boundless cosmos of Aethel
Yet he knew Lyra’s intent was pure.
her fertile soil alone could not summon such wealth without Kaelen’s initial leap of faith

note: Covenant of the Harvest, Law of Perfect Balance; fifty-fifty with unseen Keepers; no sanction.

quotes.text: the Tender rejected the Fog’s whispers to hoard the bounty
she divided the harvest perfectly in half
In the ancient valley of Aethel, the sacred dance
She knew the River’s true intent.

note: River-Spirit and Soil-Maiden; give all, equal half; fog whispers greed, rejected; no sanction.

quotes.text: The mist hissed, urging Elara to hoard the bounty
divided the golden apples perfectly in half
In the eternal Valley of Aethel, the Mist of Veils clung heavily to the River of Echoes
He knew her intent was pure

note: River of Echoes, Mist of Veils; fifty-fifty division of whatever arrives; mist urges hoarding, ignored.

phrase: Law of (the) Perfect Balance: divide the harvest exactly in half
note: Also shared imagery: Law of Reversal (Agents 1,3,7), celestial blade (3,7), Great Balance (3,5,8), Soil of Threefold Abundance (1,3).
